capabilities: Search note names and recent note contents from the new tab
Show recently edited notes with folder and time since change
Show Obsidian bookmarks for notes, headings and blocks
Replay or copy recent ecu-terminal commands
Show clock and date, with per-section toggles
extras: Manual install only: copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into .obsidian/plugins/ecu-newtab/. Makes no network requests. Content search covers the 3,000 (desktop) or 800 (mobile) most recently edited notes. Commands containing words like password, token or secret are not recorded, and credential-looking text is hidden. Interface in English and Turkish.
problem: Obsidian's empty new tab gives no quick way to search notes or return to recently edited work.

relations.evidence: Optional companions: ecu-terminal for the Terminal panel button and recent commands
ecu-codekit, which runs commands with a safety check for risky ones
Bookmarks from Obsidian's Bookmarks core plugin: notes, headings and blocks

summary: New tab page with a search box, recently edited notes, Obsidian bookmarks, recent terminal commands, and a clock.
